quizGuardRationale: Direct pairwise hypotheses for independent review; symmetric, nontransitive, not inherited synonym cliques. English title acceptability and actual secondary meanings matter, not spelling or POS alone.
筆記 compares writingdown/copying and actual recorded-writing senses, not every writing tool. 筆者 compares genuine writer/author roles without claiming exclusive article/book partitions.

ひっくり返す/ひっくり返る compare actual reversal, turning and toppling facets; transitivity alone does not establish absence or presence of quiz ambiguity. 引っ越し compares actual relocation;引っ込む actual intransitive recess/withdrawal including ordinary secondary senses of引く/隠れる.

一通り distinguishes general pass, nearlywhole coverage, ordinarynegative and one-method. No numerical approximation or exactlyonce synonym rule. たいてい ordinarynegative4 is considered beyond older primarytitle.
ひとまず compares actual fornow facets, includingまず4 andしばらく3, not an automatic once/first/temporary clique. 人通り/通り considers actualtraffic2 beyond oldstreettitle.
必需品 names essentialarticles;必要 has nounneed and日用品 dailyarticles facets. 人差し指 compares broader指, not every digit. 瞳 compares eyes with目, not school-pupil English homonyms.

一休み compares shortrest with genuine rest facets, not holidays or every leisurely manner. 独り言 compares speech facets without equating whispering/publicspeech with selftalk. ひとりでに compares actual自然/自動 spontaneous/automatic uses, not deliberate lone agency.

皮肉 includes irony/contraryoutcome and older superficial/body recognition without invented etymology. 日にち compares actual calendar-date/day-count identities, includingデートcalendar2, not日日daily family or every numberedday.

捻る compares actual twisting/turning and ordinary devise/compose/defeateasily facets;頭をひねる is a wholeconstruction, not free cognitive synonymy. 日の入り compares暮れsunset1 and沈むsunsetting rather than automatically every夕方/duskperiod.
